description: Extract structured fields from supplier invoices for the aws-idp-demo-lab reference architecture.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number exactly as shown on the document. Do not invent a value.

vendor_name.description: Legal or trading name of the supplier issuing the invoice.

invoice_date.description: Invoice issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format; derive only from a date present on the document.

due_date.description: Payment due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, only if present on the invoice.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code corresponding to the invoice currency.

subtotal.description: Subtotal amount before taxes, if explicitly stated.

tax_amount.description: Total tax amount shown on the invoice, if present.

total_amount.description: Final invoice total payable; do not substitute subtotal.
